title: Learning Stipend Programs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Learning Stipend Programs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Learning Stipend Programs — stipends paying people to learn.

Phase 1 — Prove (stipend cards): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (outcome proof): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (fraud guards): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and learners-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
